class.name: arxlift2s_ros2_control/ArxX5Hardware
class.description: ARX X5 single-arm SystemInterface (Stanford arx5-sdk / Arx5JointController). Instantiate once per arm for LIFT2S: left can1, right can3. Params: robot_model (default X5), can_interface (alias can_name), control_mode full_control|position|pd_control, joint_k_gains, joint_d_gains, gripper_kp, gripper_kd. Always exports MIX position/velocity/effort/kp/kd; control_mode selects write() (same contract as panthera-ht). Gripper stays position-only. Official InterfacesThread arm path is retired from this package.

class.name: arxlift2s_ros2_control/ArxLiftHardware
class.description: ARX LIFT2S lift-column SystemInterface (LiftHeadControlLoop / libarx_lift_src on CAN). Exactly one joint (typically lift_joint); height unit meters. Params: can_name (default can5), robot_type 0=LIFT / 1=X7S / 2=LIFTS (use 2 for LIFT2S). Does not export waist, head, or chassis; activate parks chassis via setChassisCmd(0,0,0,2). Background loop() thread ~400 Hz. Mutex: do not share CAN with official lift_controller nodes.
